title: Organisms exist, but they neither have nor are selves

statements.text: Conscious beings so far known neither have nor are a self. Organisms exist, and some have conscious self-models, but those self-models are complex brain states, not selves. The systems constantly confuse themselves with the content of their self-model, and the experienced substantiality, essence and individuality of the self are representational content that was useful in evolution but is not epistemically justified.

sources.quote: we are systems that constantly confuse themselves with the content of their PSM
they neither have nor are a self
Possessing this content on the level of phenomenal experience was evolutionary advantageous
